name: PTC India Ltd
tagline: Mature, low-growth power-trading utility with a resolved governance cleanup and an unproven SOTP value-unlock thesis
business_overview: PTC India is a power-trading company (with historical generation/financing arms, since partly divested) that facilitates electricity trading between generators and distributors in India.
fundamentals_narrative: Weak trailing fundamentals: negative 5-year revenue growth and a modest ~10.7% ROE, consistent with a mature, thin-margin power-trading business. technical_read: Not checked -- weak fundamentals and lack of a confirmed catalyst were decisive.
